paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter: Dark E-Field Radio Pilot Experiment
notes: Measured pilot-phase limits from 50-300 MHz frequency scan (Figure 12, blue curve). Dark photon mass derived from frequency via E=hf. Paper explicitly states kinetic mixing parameter ε = 6.4×10^-11 at 70.5 MHz from signal injection test (page 7). Four spot-frequency measurements at 63.9, 70.5, 152, and 247 MHz (orange dots in Figure 12) extrapolated to one month integration time using sensitivity scaling law. Kinetic mixing parameter ε and χ are equivalent (χ used in AxionLimitBench convention). This is a proof-of-concept pilot run with limited integration time (3.8 hours base data); Phase-I and Phase-II projections shown in green and black curves would achieve better sensitivity with longer integration and improved electronics.
